description: I am so pleased that State Senator Claire Wilson and longtime community advocate Cynthia Ricks-Maccotan joined me for my virtual campaign kickoff. Through the virtues of technology, we are still able to connect with friends, neighbors and other community members throughout the 30th district and beyond.
